entities.summary: Jesse Hutchakowski, known professionally as Jesse Hutch, is a Canadian and American actor. He spends his time traveling between the USA and Canada. He worked on the television show American Dreams as Jimmy Riley, romantic interest of main character Meg Pryor. In 2007, he played a major character on the Sci-Fi Channel TV-movie Termination Point. Most recently, he had a recurring role in the second season of Arrow and the second season of Batwoman.
